cssVars: Labels, legends and native control text

propDocs.Field.invalid: Force invalid or valid display; omit for browser validation after submission.
propDocs.Field.disabled: Disable the control and mark every part.
propDocs.FieldSet.disabled: Disable all controls except those in its legend.
propDocs.FieldError.match: Validity key for displaying an error, or true/false to force it.
